title: Bomboclat
blurb: A Jamaican patois exclamation that travelled far beyond Jamaica and lost roughly none of its force along the way. It is used for shock, for emphasis, and for moments that have comprehensively exceeded ordinary vocabulary — the internet adopted it as both a caption format and a reaction, often without much idea of its literal meaning or its weight as a curse. The delivery carries something that survives translation entirely intact. Use it dramatically, use it respectfully, and be aware that anybody who grew up around the word will clock exactly how you are using it.
origin: The Jamaican patois exclamation, adopted globally as a shock reaction.
